ambiguous_facts.subject: ship
ambiguous_facts.why: The app's vocabulary wants the moulded beam at the main deck and says never to use an overall beam. The sheet says 'maximum' under a 'molded' heading. A careful reader may report it or skip it; both are defensible. Not scored.

ambiguous_facts.subject: masthead_forward
ambiguous_facts.stated: MASTHEAD LIGHT (WHITE, MASTHEAD) 38'-6" ABOVE MAIN DECK (sheet 2)
ambiguous_facts.why: The vessel has two masthead lights (a masthead/towing light on the mast and a masthead light forward), and COLREG measures above the uppermost continuous deck, which the sheet doesn't confirm is the main deck. Not scored.
